TestUploadPathInheritsHelperDurability.t.note: The SQLite upload and replace paths linearized the stored managed PDF in place (maybe_linearize_pdf_in_place) and fsync_managed_pdf_parent synced the managed directory after it. PG-C2 deleted both paths and that helper: the PostgreSQL ingest linearizes into a separate working file (linearize_pdf_to) before the immutable object is stored.
